purpose: Validate next pilot candidates before authorization

candidates.customer_data_risk_reason: Contact is sub-resource of client; workspace scoping guaranteed by parent context
candidates.rationale: Contact PATCH is simplest next step. Service already accepts CanonicalAuthContext, identical to R1-SERVICE-3. No adapter needed. Nested under client workspace context. Low risk for customer data (contact is sub-resource). Straightforward modernization.

candidates.customer_data_risk_reason: DELETE semantics carry higher risk than PATCH. Deactivation vs hard delete distinction matters. Need verification of soft-delete vs hard-delete semantics.
candidates.rationale: DELETE handler has different semantics than PATCH (deactivate vs hard delete). Requires separate audit of soft-delete logic and retention requirements. Defer to after contact PATCH is confirmed safe.

candidates.customer_data_risk_reason: Diagnosis is critical business data. Service contract unknown. POST operation creates new record. Multiple unknowns require full design audit.
candidates.rationale: Service contract unknown. POST operation (creation) has different semantics than PATCH. Insufficient information for safe pilot. Requires full service audit and design review before modernization.

candidates.customer_data_risk_reason: Decisions are critical governance data with compliance implications. Service contract unknown. POST to create/intake/submit has complex state machine semantics. Multiple unknowns.
candidates.rationale: Service contract unknown. POST operation (creation/state transitions) has complex semantics. Decisions have governance and compliance implications. Requires full audit of decision lifecycle before modernization.

authorized_next_pilot.reason: Contact PATCH is logical next step. Service accepts CanonicalAuthContext (same as R1-SERVICE-3). Nested under client context. No adapter needed. Pattern proven in R1-SERVICE-2 and R1-SERVICE-3.

deferred_candidates.reason: Different HTTP semantics (delete vs patch). Requires separate audit of soft-delete logic.
Service contract unknown. Critical business data. Requires design audit.
Service contract unknown. Governance implications. Complex state machine semantics.

scaling_strategy.step_1: Contact PATCH (clients/[clientId]/contacts/[contactId] PATCH + updateContact) - direct pass pattern
scaling_strategy.step_2: Contact DELETE (deferred - requires delete semantics audit)
scaling_strategy.step_3: Other nested routes (e.g., engagement actions, etc.) - similar patterns
scaling_strategy.step_4: Complex POST operations (diagnosis, decisions) - deferred until after nested routes proven
